title: Mitigating Barren Plateaus via Domain Decomposition in Variational Quantum Algorithms for Nonlinear PDEs
summary: Barren plateaus present a major challenge in the training of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs), particularly for large-scale discretizations of nonlinear partial differential equations. In this work, we introduce a domain decomposition framework to mitigate barren plateaus by localizing the cost functional. Our strategy is based on partitioning the spatial domain into overlapping subdomains, each associated with a localized parameterized quantum circuit and measurement operator.
